module.summary: Validated half-open usize interval with checked length construction.
module.long_description: Validated half-open usize interval with checked length construction.

purpose.primary: Provide one overflow-safe boundary convention for regions and extents.

c_pain.summary: Start/end and start/length pairs overflow, reverse, and disagree about inclusivity.
c_pain.where_c_degrades: Every caller must recreate their relationship and boundary policy.

zig_response.summary: Construct a validated range and centralize all boundary operations.
remaining_programmer_responsibilities: choose the correct unit and address domain
decide whether empty ranges are meaningful
